title: The Pink Gift Guide, Stocking to New Year's Eve
intro: A gift guide should get you through the whole season with one order, not six. The tumbler is the present everyone actually wants, the velvet jewelry box is the one that looks like more than it cost, packing cubes and a satin bonnet fill the stocking, and the bow flutes and the 2027 planner carry the pile straight into New Year's Eve. All six ship from a US warehouse and the Christmas order-by date is on every page.

Detail shot of a woman's hands wrapping a pink velvet jewelry box in blush paper at a farmhouse kitchen island, a pink 40 oz tumbler, a pink 2027 planner and two bow champagne flutes beside her.
